forum.title: STM32H743VIT6 Read VBat with ADC3 using DMA don`t work in CubeIDE 2.2.1
forum.best_answer_content:
*> sConfig.SamplingTime = ADC\_SAMPLETIME\_1CYCLE\_5;*

Slow down the rate of conversions so it isn't stuck in interrupts forever.
